key_insight: MentalHospital is a virtual psychiatric encounter benchmark that tests LLMs across the full S.O.A.P. workflow, not just isolated tasks.
clinical_relevance: It offers a more realistic way to evaluate whether AI can support end-to-end psychiatric interviewing, assessment, and treatment planning.
method: Built from 1,193 de-identified psychiatric EHR cases spanning major ICD-11 categories and 76 disorders.
Uses skill-augmented standardized patients and a dual-track scoring system: objective reference matching plus subjective process evaluation.
Introduces MentalEval, five specialist evaluators for empathy, professionalism, note quality, diagnostic rigor, and treatment appropriateness.
evidence_signal: Clinician survey responses (n=22) rated the environment’s fidelity at 3.88/5, and MentalEval showed strong expert alignment with average QWK of 0.944.
watch_item: Because the benchmark relies on simulated encounters and expert-rated rubrics, performance may not fully capture real-world psychiatric complexity or safety risks.
paper_title: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
